items.title: The Rhythm We Make
items.blurb: An album about the imperfect art of understanding each other: twelve songs of soul, R&B and funk about misunderstandings, private jokes and finding the beat again.
items.note: From the editor's studio: John is a co-founder of WeAreQuadCities.
items.ai: Original lyrics and creative direction by the artist; music and vocals developed with AI-assisted production tools.
